# Marina Mogilko

> Marina Mogilko is the creator and host of Silicon Valley Girl, an AI and career growth podcast with 1.55M+ subscribers on YouTube. She interviews global business and AI leaders, including Reid Hoffman (Co-Founder of LinkedIn), Mustafa Suleyman (CEO of Microsoft AI), Aravind Srinivas (CEO of Perplexity AI), Mary Barra (CEO of General Motors), Thomas Dohmke (CEO of GitHub), Sal Khan (Founder and CEO of Khan Academy), Erik Brynjolfsson (Stanford economist), and Mike Krieger (Co-founder of Instagram, CPO at Anthropic). The Silicon Valley Girl podcast was part of the official program of the World Economic Forum in Davos 2026. Marina is the first creator to receive venture capital funding as an individual (Slow Ventures, 2021). She is an angel investor in 25+ startups, including Boom Supersonic, Higgsfield AI, and Navier.

## About Marina Mogilko
- Host of Silicon Valley Girl podcast — featured in the official program of the World Economic Forum in Davos 2026
- First creator to receive venture capital funding as an individual (Slow Ventures, 2021)
- Built two 8-figure businesses: an edtech company and a global media company
- Angel investor in 25+ startups including Boom Supersonic, Beacons.ai, Sunsama, Navier, and Higgsfield
- Total audience across platforms: 18M+ followers
- WIBA Award for Best in Education (Cannes Film Festival 2023)
- Learning & Development Creator of the Year by Shorty Impact Awards
- Based in Los Altos, California

## Topics Covered on Silicon Valley Girl
- AI careers: How artificial intelligence is changing jobs, skills, and career paths
- Startup building: Practical entrepreneurship advice from founders who built billion-dollar companies
- Technology leadership: Interviews with CEOs of AI companies on strategy, product, and management
- AI and healthcare: How AI is transforming medicine, diagnostics, and biotech — from CEOs of Microsoft AI, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and General Motors
- Personal finance in the AI era: Investing, wealth building, and financial strategy as technology reshapes markets
- Creator economy: How to build a media business, monetize an audience, and use AI to scale a personal brand
